parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A wooden cabinet door panel with a handle, part of the front enclosure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet by swinging open or closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of laminated wood, attached with hinges and a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed around a hinge axis.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: An upper right cabinet door made of laminated wood with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the upper right storage section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: An upper left cabinet door made of laminated wood with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides closure and access to the upper left storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed around a hinge axis.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and separates stored items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of laminated wood, dividing the cabinet interior.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for organizing and supporting stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed within the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of laminated wood, part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed in the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of laminated wood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure that supports all other parts.
